# Setup

## Data Source

Our data is retrieved from 

https://opendata.dc.gov/datasets/DCGIS::urban-forestry-street-trees/about

## Loading required packages

```{r}
#| label: load-library-chunk
#| output: FALSE
#| warning: FALSE
#| echo: TRUE
invisible(lapply(c("tidyverse", "class", "MASS", "mice"), library, character.only=TRUE))
```

```{r}
#| echo: TRUE

forestry.all <- suppressMessages(invisible(read_csv(file = "../01_EDA/data/Urban_Forestry_Street_Trees.csv", col_select = c(-36,-37,-40))))
```

```{r}

```


```{r, cache=TRUE}
cleantheforest <- function(data) {
  data <- data[c(-109328,-206288,-160226),]
  data |> mutate(MIN_CROWN_BASE = ifelse(MIN_CROWN_BASE < 0,0,MIN_CROWN_BASE)) -> data
  return(data)
}
# Minimum Crown Base cannot be negative. This is an artifact from approximations done by lidar.
# The best guess here is to treat the negative values as zeroes though this may introduce bias.

cleantheforest(forestry.all) -> cleaned.forest

cleaned.forest |> dplyr::select(CONDITION, DBH, MBG_WIDTH, MBG_LENGTH, TBOX_L, TBOX_W, MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT, MAX_MEAN, MIN_CROWN_BASE, DTM_MEAN, PERIM) |> drop_na() |> relocate(CONDITION) -> forestry.droppednas

clean.scaled <- cleaned.forest |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~ as.numeric(scale(.x))))

imp <- mice(clean.scaled)
```

```{r}
imputed.forest <- complete(imp)
```

```{r}
imputed.forest |> summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "column", values_to = "n_na") %>%
  filter(n_na > 0)
```

```{r}


imputed.forest |> 
  dplyr::select(CONDITION, DBH, MBG_WIDTH, MBG_LENGTH, 
                TBOX_L, TBOX_W, MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT, MAX_MEAN,
                MIN_CROWN_BASE, DTM_MEAN, PERIM,
                GENUS_NAME, SIDEWALK, WIRES, CURB, OWNERSHIP) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
# The columns that have no condition after our imputation
# can't provide us with any training data to classify on.
forest.ready <- imputed.forest %>%
  dplyr::select(CONDITION, DBH, MBG_WIDTH, MBG_LENGTH, 
                TBOX_L, TBOX_W, MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT, MAX_MEAN,
                MIN_CROWN_BASE, DTM_MEAN, PERIM,
                GENUS_NAME, SIDEWALK, WIRES, CURB, OWNERSHIP) %>% drop_na() %>%
  mutate(SIDEWALK = fct_lump_min(SIDEWALK, min = 1000, other_level = "Other")) |> mutate(WIRES = fct_lump_min(WIRES, min = 1000, other_level = "Other")) |> mutate(CURB = fct_lump_min(CURB, min = 1000, other_level = "Other")) |> mutate(OWNERSHIP = fct_lump_min(OWNERSHIP, min = 1000, other_level = "Other")) |> mutate(across(where(is.factor) & !CONDITION, ~ fct_lump_min(.x, min = 1000)))
```

```{r}
forest.ready %>% summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))
```

```{r}
colnames(forest.ready)
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
#| label: initial-lda-condition
#| output: true
#| echo: true
set.seed(1234)

train.ratio = 7/10

sample.index = sample(x = 1:nrow(forest.ready), size = floor(train.ratio*nrow(forest.ready)))

forest.ready.train <- forest.ready[sample.index,]
forest.ready.test <- forest.ready[-sample.index,]

lda.training.model <- lda(CONDITION ~ . - CONDITION, data = forest.ready.train)

lda.predictions <- predict(lda.training.model, newdata = forest.ready.test)

table(forest.ready.test$CONDITION,lda.predictions$class)
```

```{r}
mean(lda.predictions$class != forest.ready.test$CONDITION)
```

```{r}
# Leave one out cross validation
lda.model.cv <- lda(CONDITION ~ . - CONDITION, data = forest.ready, CV=TRUE)

mean(lda.model.cv$class != forest.ready$CONDITION)
```

```{r}
forest.ready |> colnames()
```


```{r, cache = TRUE}
#| label: initial-qda-condition
#| output: true
#| echo: true
qda.training.model <- qda(CONDITION ~ . - CONDITION - GENUS_NAME - , data = forest.ready.train)

qda.predictions <- predict(qda.training.model, newdata = forest.ready.test)

table(forest.ready.test$CONDITION, qda.predictions$class)
```

```{r}
mean(qda.predictions$class != forest.ready.test$CONDITION)
```

```{r}
qda.model.cv <- qda(CONDITION ~ . - CONDITION - GENUS_NAME - CURB - WIRES - SIDEWALK - OWNERSHIP, data = forest.ready, CV=TRUE)

mean(qda.model.cv$class == forest.ready$CONDITION)

```

```{r}
base_drop <- c("CONDITION", "GENUS_NAME", "CURB", "WIRES", "SIDEWALK", "OWNERSHIP")
preds <- setdiff(names(forest.ready), base_drop)

n_fail <- sapply(preds, function(p) {
  f <- reformulate(setdiff(preds, p), response = "CONDITION")
  fit <- tryCatch(qda(f, data = forest.ready, CV = TRUE), error = function(e) NULL)
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NA)
  sum(is.na(fit$class))
})

sort(n_fail)
```

```{r}
table(forest.ready$CONDITION)   # how many Good trees are there?

good <- forest.ready[forest.ready$CONDITION == "Good", preds]
round(cor(good), 2)             # look for |r| > 0.95
summary(good)                   # look for extreme maxima
```

```{r}
num_vars <- c("DBH","TBOX_L","TBOX_W","MBG_WIDTH","MBG_LENGTH","PERIM",
              "MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT","MAX_MEAN","MIN_CROWN_BASE","DTM_MEAN")

extreme <- apply(abs(forest.ready[num_vars]) > 10, 1, any)
sum(extreme)
forest.ready[extreme, c("CONDITION", num_vars)]
```

```{r}
forest.clean <- forest.ready[!extreme, ]
```

```{r}
qda.model.cv <- qda(CONDITION ~ DBH + MBG_LENGTH + TBOX_L + TBOX_W + MAX_CROWN_HEIGHT + MIN_CROWN_BASE + DTM_MEAN, data = forest.clean, CV = TRUE)

sum(is.na(qda.model.cv$class))
mean(qda.model.cv$class != forest.clean$CONDITION)
```
